issues.description: Constructor parameter types for Bitmap24 are inconsistent between the header and implementation in the template repository. In example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp the non-default constructor is declared as Bitmap24(long i_width, long i_height) but in example_program/src/Bitmap24.cpp it is defined as Bitmap24::Bitmap24(int p_width, int p_height). This mismatch will change the mangled constructor signature and can cause compilation/linker errors for students using the template. The solution repository uses the int signature (matching the implementation), indicating the template header is likely incorrect.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the constructor declaration in example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp match the implementation. Change the header declaration from Bitmap24(long i_width, long i_height) to Bitmap24(int i_width, int i_height) (or alternatively change the implementation to use long) so header and implementation signatures are identical. Ensure both template and solution headers are consistent.
